name: onboarding-progress
description: Read and record progress on the principal's onboarding task. status: the open and done topics of each playbook session (with the playbook text for open ones), whether a mailbox is connected and whether the greeting was sent. open_session: create the topics of a later playbook session (review, check-in, ongoing-rhythm) before running it; safe to repeat. topic_done: mark one topic done, or declined, with a note of what was chosen and applied or why it was declined; onboarding completes itself when the last topic is done. greeting_sent: record that the first greeting went out. operator_notice: record something the operator needs to act on.

inputs.session_id: string? (open_session: the playbook session id from status, e.g. review. topic_done: only when the same topic id is open in two sessions)
inputs.topic_id: string? (topic_done: the topic id from status, e.g. style)
inputs.note: string? (topic_done, required there: what the principal chose and what you applied, or why they declined)
inputs.details: object? (operator_notice: facts the operator needs, e.g. { outcome, clientId } for mailbox_signin_blocked)

outputs.sessions: array? (status: [{ id, title, opened, open: [{ topicId, title, body, needsMailbox }], done: [{ topicId, title }] }])
outputs.topics: array? (open_session: the session's topics with their status)
outputs.createdSubtasks: number? (open_session: how many topics were added now)
outputs.onboardingComplete: boolean? (topic_done: true when this completed onboarding)
